name: Andorra
blurb: A Pyrenean principality for skiing, hiking and duty-free shopping.
cities: Duty-free shopping street and the Caldea thermal spa.
The Pyrenees' largest ski area, with mountain biking in summer.
Ski slopes in winter and a bike park in summer.
A glacial valley of stone shepherd huts and high mountain trails above Andorra la Vella.
